description: Per-chain capability, retention boundary and fee model. When to use: before promising that some query is possible, or when a tool refused a query as out of range. Do not use: for live numbers (that is chain_status). Returns: one row per chain {chain, tier, name, client, state, capability}, plus the fee models we support and an honesty note. Key fact: RobotBase publishes no RPC endpoint - every read path is this MCP surface.
name: robotbase_capabilities
